nodes.title: note: UNET
widgets_values: Loads the flux1-schnell diffusion model from a 4-bit GGUF quant (fits 8GB VRAM). This is the design-permitted fallback while krea2 has no weights on disk. The ComfyClient ban-check reads unet_name here.

nodes.title: note: CLIP
widgets_values: Flux needs two text encoders: clip_l (short tag understanding) + t5xxl fp8 (long natural-language prompts). Both live in ComfyUI/models/clip on the SSD.

nodes.title: note: VAE
widgets_values: Flux autoencoder (ae.safetensors) that turns the denoised latent back into pixels at node 15.

nodes.title: note: LATENT
widgets_values: Blank 16-channel latent canvas (flux uses the SD3-style latent space, hence this node instead of EmptyLatentImage). Patched to 1216x704 for panels/plates, 832x1216 portrait for character refs.

nodes.title: note: PROMPT_POS
widgets_values: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient: character anchors + location anchor + composition + style tail, 120-word budget). Also reused as the 'negative' input on node 14 because schnell runs CFG 1.0, where the negative is ignored.

nodes.title: note: GUIDANCE
widgets_values: Flux's distilled-guidance knob (not classic CFG). 3.5 is the standard default: higher = stricter prompt following but stiffer images.

nodes.title: note: SAMPLER
widgets_values: The actual denoising loop. schnell is step-distilled: 4 steps, euler, cfg 1.0 is the intended recipe (more steps does NOT improve it). SEED is patched per shot from hash(scene_id, shot_id, retry) so every panel is reproducible from its sidecar json.

nodes.title: note: DECODE
widgets_values: Latent -> RGB pixels via the VAE from node 3.

nodes.title: note: SAVE
widgets_values: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient then copies it into the project's panels/refs directory and renames it deterministically.

nodes.title: note: UNET
widgets_values: Loads krea2 (Krea-2-Turbo), the design-mandated primary model (design 5.3b), from a Q4_K_S GGUF quant. image_router.pick_template() only routes here once this file exists on disk at its full size -- see pipeline/image_router.py. The ComfyClient ban-check reads unet_name here.

nodes.title: note: CLIP
widgets_values: krea2 text encoder: Qwen3-VL-4B 'fp8_scaled' from the official Comfy-Org/Krea-2 repackaged repo (found 2026-07-11 via the community workflow's source URLs).

nodes.title: note: VAE
widgets_values: Qwen-Image VAE (AutoencoderKLQwenImage, 16-channel latent) -- NOT flux's ae.safetensors. Feeds node 15's decode.

nodes.title: note: LATENT
widgets_values: 16-channel latent canvas sized for the Qwen-Image VAE (NOT EmptyLatentImage). Patched to 1216x704 for panels/plates, 832x1216 portrait for character refs.

nodes.title: note: PROMPT_POS
widgets_values: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient). Also feeds node 12's zero-out negative.

nodes.title: note: NEG_ZEROOUT
widgets_values: krea2-Turbo is CFG-distilled (KSampler cfg=1.0), so a text negative has no effect -- per the model card and the validated panel_txt2img_krea.json graph, the negative conditioning is a zero-out of the positive instead of a second CLIPTextEncode. There is no PROMPT_NEG patch title on this template.

nodes.title: note: SAMPLER
widgets_values: krea2-Turbo's validated recipe (panel_txt2img_krea.json proof render, 2026-07-10): euler/simple, 8 steps, cfg 1.0, denoise 1.0 -- krea2 is not flux, do not change without a fresh model_lab proof render. SEED is patched per shot from hash(scene_id, shot_id, retry) so every panel is reproducible from its sidecar json.

nodes.title: note: DECODE
widgets_values: Latent -> RGB pixels via the Qwen-Image VAE from node 3.

nodes.title: note: SAVE
widgets_values: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient then copies it into the project's panels/refs directory and renames it deterministically.
